title: General Manager - Central Projects
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Resource Planning (Man, Material, Machine/Equipment). Develop different SITE SCOPE of WORK. Ensure all projects are delivered On-time within Scope and Budget. Manage daily on-site operations such as headcount, attendance of employees to ensure employee’s availability during working hours. Educate and Train all Existing & Newly hired employees in line with company policies and procedures. Coordinate with supervisors and management to plan activities for higher productivity on production site. Organize business review meetings with clients to improve performance continuously and qualitatively. Develop and maintain relationship with management and supervisors to resolve employee issues, concerns and grievances as per existing company policy. Develop ways to retain all employees through motivation and encouragement. Coordinate with internal resources for flawless execution of projects. Monitor Work Progress on a daily basis. Maintain Quality Control procedure by conducting Quality Inspection. Ensure Site Safety by conducting SAFETY INSPECTION. Provide high level customer service and ensure compliance to all company’s rules and regulations. Ensure customer satisfaction by responding to customer enquiries in responsive manner. Ensure timely submission of Employee Attendance to Central Payroll Team Ensure Timely submission of LEAVE REPORTS. MIS Report (Daily Budgeted Expense data with Supporting bills, Project Completion Status, Current Headcount, Employee Turnover Rate & Reasons, Site Safety Inspection Report)

Key Skills: Project Management,PMP,Project Documentation,Project Coordination,Project Planning,Management,General,General management
